VCEN - Vertically Centered Glyphs

#1# 25% 2*3+4^5=1030 5-4/2=3 8|7=15 23:59 @H@ /H/ \H\ (H) [H] {H} <H> ~H~
#1# 25% 2*3+4^5=1030 5-4/2=3 8|7=15 23:59 @H@ /H/ \H\ (H) [H] {H} <H> ~H~

Many glyphs are normally centered at half the ex-height, or the vertical middle of the lower case. This stylistic set aligns them with half the cap-height.
